design_review_scope: Common wire definitions and pure parser preparation; not full v5 service/persistence design acceptance

technical_choices.U1: Only closed error vocabulary here. Later host tests bind not_found for unknown IDs, stale for revision mismatch, conflict for same-revision state conflicts per TEST-STRATEGY; do not implement state mapping in this module.
technical_choices.U2: Generic Result value with explicit host-selected decoder; each provider binds its actual result type later.
technical_choices.U3: Use one flat kind discriminator for C12 actions and every shared fixture.
technical_choices.U4: Unprovided model Ref is invalid_input at the model-output parsing boundary; host availability/permission failures remain separate.
technical_choices.U5: Compose supports text/plain and text/markdown consistent with C08.
technical_choices.U6: Ref structural validity alone does not prove artifact provenance; VER host must validate artifact kind and saved identity.
technical_choices.U7: Do not invent lexical/semantic permission rules in pure types. Target/operation adapters enforce actual resource/grant constraints.
technical_choices.U8: Optional lookup source_refs may be absent; explicit null is invalid.
technical_choices.U9: Grant non-expansion, request scope, source availability and current epoch checks are mandatory host responsibilities in later modules.
technical_choices.U10: Document Python integer parsing limit and bounded invalid_input conversion.

additional_coordinator_check: raise ... from None suppresses traceback chaining but retains __context__. Require test evidence that raw JSON decoder exceptions are not reachable as cause/context on ContractError.
adoption_status: Technical wire choices scoped for INT00; final code integration waits exact-file independent review and SOL tests. Full v5 product/capability adoption is not implied.
next_steps: Record final wire disposition and shared examples before downstream modules
